hooks.command: jq -r '.session_id' | { read -r sid; marker="/tmp/.claude_claudemd_reminder_${sid:-unknown}"; if [ -f "$marker" ]; then exit 0; fi; touch "$marker"; printf '%s' '{"decision":"block","reason":"Before stopping: (mind is in BETA, so this is optional) consider whether this session produced anything durable that a future agent would otherwise re-learn (a gotcha, a verified rule, a decision, a working command). If so, capture each with: python3 mind/mind.py add --title ... --kind rule|lesson|howto|decision|gotcha|reference --evidence FILING-CHECKED|DATA-INFERRED|CODE-CHECKED|ASSUMED --tags ... --paths ... --body ... (search first so you do not duplicate; use amend for an existing entry). Do NOT add it to CLAUDE.md, which is already too large. If a mind entry you used was wrong, run mind.py feedback <id> wrong. Optionally rate how useful the mind was this session with: python3 mind/mind.py rate 0-5 (0 = did not use it, which is neutral and fine; add --outside if the real win came from going beyond it). If nothing is worth capturing, or it does not fit, just say so briefly and stop normally."}'; }
